facts.fact: 章首：Vasara 打发 Bron 独留 Andra——她提谈判"用自己换 Lucas 和 Rayner"
facts.anchor: Andra watched through swollen eyes as Vasara relieved her henchman of his duties

facts.fact: 毁灭性问句：村庄几个月前就已被毁？——真假无法验证；她只补"南方树林真能打"
facts.anchor: Truly believe you could protect a village that was destroyed months ago?

facts.fact: "该归还了"：弹指让 Lucas 尸体悬浮扭断——四肢逐一折断下颌脱臼如提线木偶
facts.anchor: Another snap of Vasara’s fingers had Lucas’s unconscious form rising upward through the frozen tunnel of stone

facts.fact: 黑雾从 Lucas 口中退出冲上塔顶——躯体砸落：眼无神皮腐恶臭；Lucas 早就死了
facts.anchor: a black vapor exited through his mouth and gathered in the cold space in front of him

facts.fact: 爬到 Lucas 身边——呕吐不止；"Lucas was dead."躯体早已开始腐坏
facts.anchor: The stench surrounding him now made sense; his body was decomposing.

facts.fact: 强制回放记忆：袭村夜过去 Andra 风法无效——黑雾钻入 Bernice 体内（Bernice 掐喉说通牒）
facts.anchor: she was unsuccessful as the black vapor raced into Bernice’s body.

facts.fact: 记忆续：Lucas 箭无致命——爪穿腹+咬穿肩被甩上砖墙
facts.anchor: stabbing elongated claws through the center of Lucas’s abdomen, pulling Lucas close to him as he snarled in his face.

facts.fact: 真 Lucas 遗言：独自咳血喊 Andra 她没听见——"对不起""我爱你，cousin"咽气
facts.anchor: “I love you, cousin,” Lucas whispered to the night.

facts.fact: 交接仪式：黑雾从 Bernice 尸体钻进 Lucas——骨复位走进黑暗；"It hadn't been Lucas all along."
facts.anchor: the black vapor that had inhabited Bernice’s body rush into Lucas’s. His eyes opened, black and glaring

facts.fact: 章末：Gerrick 活着满脸悔意现身——"I'm so sorry, witch"
facts.anchor: He lowered his hood, and with regret etched into every crevice of his features, he looked at her.
